decl: func (f *Factory) GetOrNew(packetType packetio.BufferPacketType, ssrc uint32) io.ReadWriteCloser
summary: Returns an existing or newly created RTP buffer or RTCP reader for the requested packet type and SSRC.
summary_step: 1. Locks the factory while looking up and mutating buffer registries.
2. For RTCP packet requests, returns an existing reader or creates a new RTCPReader, stores it, and registers an on-close cleanup callback.
3. For RTP packet requests, returns an existing Buffer or creates a new Buffer with configured tracking limits and stores it by SSRC.
4. Checks pending RTX mappings so a newly created repair or base buffer can be linked to its counterpart immediately.
5. Registers an on-close cleanup callback that removes the RTP buffer and any RTX mapping keyed by the same SSRC.
6. Returns nil for unsupported packet types.

decl: func (f *Factory) SetRTXPair(repair, base uint32, rsid string)
summary: Registers or applies an RTX repair-to-base SSRC mapping and optionally notifies the base buffer of the repair SSRC.
summary_step: 1. Locks the factory and looks up existing repair and base RTP buffers.
2. Stores the repair-to-base SSRC mapping when either side has not been created yet.
3. Unlocks before linking existing buffers to avoid holding the factory lock during buffer operations.
4. When both buffers exist, assigns the repair buffer's primary buffer and notifies the base buffer about the RTX SSRC when an RSID is supplied.
